sentence: This project studies how corneal cells and immune cells communicate with nerves in neurotrophic keratitis and which neurotrophic factors corneal cells make.
This project develops an immunotherapy that targets nerve growth factor to boost antibodies that block pain signaling in chronic pain.
This project studies the structure and function of two transporters that are coupled to ions, to understand how ion-coupled transport works.
This project studies how hostility between parents relates to harsh parenting in families with young children, and how parental self-regulation may play a part.
This project builds peptide nanostructures that make cells respond to light, to improve the maturity of human stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes.
This project studies how hematopoietic stem cells differ from one another and coordinate, including in blood and immune diseases linked to aging.
This project uses a long-read enrichment method to study where lentiviral vectors integrate in chimeric antigen receptor T-cells and how that affects gene regulation.
This project tests base editing, a type of CRISPR gene editing, to correct gene mutations in the liver, before or after birth.
This project tests whether vaccination can expand lymph node reservoirs of stem-like T cells to help cell therapy work against lung cancer tumors.
This project tries to find out which tumor features let the immune system clear glioblastoma during immunotherapy combined with personalized cancer vaccination.
This project studies how circadian rhythms control the immune responses of human airway cells and how changes in them contribute to asthma.
This project builds a microcatheter that combines intravascular imaging with physiology measurements to guide procedures in the coronary arteries.
This project builds an optical coherence scanner that images axonal tracts in the brain without labels, at micrometer resolution.
This project studies whether trophoblast development makes the placenta more sensitive to cytomegalovirus injury, using stem cell culture and a guinea pig model.
This project builds a renewable human gastric tissue culture model to study changes in gastric stem cells and how they lead to cancer.
This project works to reduce peripheral nerve stimulation in MRI by improving coil designs and monitoring tools.
This project studies how molecular signatures in airway and blood samples explain why older people do worse after severe respiratory viral infections.
This project builds a nanoparticle that delivers RNA-targeting gene therapy to prostate cancer metastases, aiming at a transcription factor.
This project provides biostatistics and bioinformatics support for study design and data analysis in related viral oncology projects.
This project studies how vascular cells push macrophages and microglia in glioblastoma toward suppressing T-cell responses, using single-cell RNA-sequencing and mouse models.
